reasons: intent_insensitive: question four is no: a different enemy intent would not have changed the line, so the intent is not part of the decision

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played all four cards: first Kaboom! on Seapunk for 7 damage and Pyro, then Bag of Tricks choosing the 3-bomb option to place 3 Bombs dealing 5 on Seapunk, then Quick Fuse on Seapunk to detonate those Bombs for 15 more damage, and finally Duck and Cover for 5 Block. This uses 2 Energy and 3 Sparks, leaving 1 Energy unused.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered the same cards in a different order, especially whether to play Bag of Tricks and Quick Fuse before Kaboom!. I chose Kaboom! first because it applies Pyro before the Bombs detonate, which is the safer order if any Pyro interaction exists, while still producing the same printed damage if it does not.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: The line gave up nothing playable from the hand, since every card was affordable. It leaves 1 Energy unused and, by taking the 3-bomb option, forgoes the 1-bomb option of Bag of Tricks, which is strictly worse here because Quick Fuse is available and the 3 Sparks are already in hand.
answers.q4_different_intent: No. The chosen line plays every affordable card and already includes Duck and Cover, so a different telegraphed enemy intent would not have changed which cards I could or should play on this turn.
